message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes clockwise; a “Reverse” card flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
2. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
3. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
4. **Wild** – You choose the next color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player catches you before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. You can also play a single round for a quick game. | | **House Variations** | • **Draw 4 on a “Draw Two”** – Some players allow a “Draw Four” to be played on a “Draw Two” if you have no matching number.
• **Stacking** – Allow players to stack “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards to pass the penalty on.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge** – Some groups skip the challenge rule for simplicity. | --- ### Quick Play‑through 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card → start discard pile. 3. Player 1 (clockwise) looks at hand. * If they can match color or number, play one card. * If they play a special card, apply its effect. * If they cannot play, draw one card. 4. Continue clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if reversed). 5. When a player empties their hand, tally points. 6. Start next round with the same deck (reshuffle if needed). --- #### Tips for Beginners - **Keep track of colors** – If you’re low on a particular color, try to play it early. - **Save “Wild Draw Four”** – Use it when you’re stuck and you have no matching color. - **Watch opponents** – If someone is about to say “UNO,” be ready to play a “Skip” or “Draw Two” to stop them. - **Use “Reverse” strategically** – In a 2‑player game, a Reverse simply passes the turn back to you, giving you another chance to play. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
